rationale_md: Germany enters this Group E fixture as overwhelming favorites, backed by a substantial 230-point Elo rating advantage over Curaçao that reflects the gulf in class between the European powerhouse and the Caribbean minnow. The model assigns Germany a 70% win probability, suggesting this should be a routine three points for the four-time World Cup champions as they navigate what appears to be one of the more manageable matches in their group stage campaign. Curaçao, despite home confederation support in CONCACAF qualifying, faces a daunting task against opponents who rarely slip up against lower-ranked opposition in tournament settings.
